newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria sees 98, 99 fed budget deficit 2.6 pct GDP.
newsitem.headline: Austria sees 98, 99 fed budget deficit 2.6 pct GDP.

text.p: Austria's budget deficit for 1998 and 1999 is expected to be 2.6 percent of gross domestic product (GDP), compared with 2.7 percent this year, a finance ministry spokesman said on Tuesday.

The budget deficit, estimated at 67.3 billion schillings in 1998 and 70.1 billion schillings in 1999, would be well in line with Maastricht criteria for the starting group of European economic and monetary union (EMU) in 1999.
